item.title: Accurate at What? Evaluating Structured GenAI vs Standard ML
item.description: Your GenAI form extractor evaluation produced 94% accuracy, but how can you ensure this is a meaningful metric for your application? Learn what that number hides and how to think about evaluating structured GenAI extraction.
